event_name: Document 44 Date 10 October 2021 Time 15:57 2021 TURKISH GRAND PRIX 7 - 10 October 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 2 (d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that ALO caused a collision with car 47 (MSC) in lap 2. ALO tried to make a move on MSC at the inside at the approach to T4, but never got in a position to complete the move and made contact with the inside rear wheel of MSC's car, causing the latter to spin. The Stewards determine that ALO is predominantly to blame.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 14 Collision With Car 47
